sections.thesis: Treasuries had one of their strongest weekly rallies of the year as concerns about the US AI trade and softer rate-rise expectations sent investors into government debt.

sections.thesis: Oil hit a five-month high after Saudi-led forces reported destroying missiles fired at the kingdom's energy hubs, with Brent settling 3.7% higher on Friday at $109.86 a barrel.
